records.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high-fidelity 16:9 desktop gameplay screen concept for an original Chinese hammer-and-sword forging game 《锤下求生》, new art direction B2 青釉断金. Intimate artisan forge of mineral indigo glazed ceramic tiles, pale ash timber, charcoal ink and a small copper furnace. Fine gold seams in a repaired ceramic surface subtly echo the sword forging trail. Central 55%: a LARGE unfinished single-edged sword laid horizontally blade-facing-camera on a modest dark anvil/workbench, five clear axial sections and two subtle lanes of ten selectable forging marks, bold hot cinnabar edge, cool blue spine, a branching fine gold forging trail. One outlined active strike mark with small hammer poised nearby; distinct material silhouettes. Sword is the hero; avoid a giant anvil hiding it.
